requested.text: The interval data shows why the annual share flatters the contract. Between 10:00 and 15:00 on a clear day the modelled solar output would cover about 55% of the plant's draw. Between 19:00 and 07:00 it covers nothing, and those twelve hours carry 52% of the plant's weekly energy, because the night shifts run the reflow and test lines hardest. On an hourly-matched basis the contract covers about 9% of consumption, roughly half the annual figure.

questions.notes: Synthetic-corpus fact; curated specification lf-kestrel-penang-phase2-power-deep-dive/p7. Human review pending; not a claim about the real world.
